title: Alongside mill
subtitle: 服务职业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）
meta: 主题语境：服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）　|　核心词汇：alongside　|　正文 333 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 alongside 的含义与所引出的成分，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1948 the shopkeeper kept the scale ① alongside the long summer at the counter, and everybody in the shop said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning: the scale had been left ② alongside the old mill, and nobody had asked a single question. The shopkeeper had come to the shop two months earlier and spoke little of the shop he had left behind him.

The account for July 1942 puts it plainer. It was done ③ alongside the men of the village, and the buyer who kept the scale had counted it ④ alongside his father twice before the winter came; nothing in the shop was ever done alongside the men of the village in those days. The buyer wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every month thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the scale at the far counter, meant something else. He said the whole business had begun ⑤ alongside the same need, and that nobody in his family had ever done it ⑥ alongside the women of the house; he was not a man who explained himself, and the shop had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1955 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the account. What the line asked for was that the scale be counted ⑦ alongside the same boat, and that the names be written ⑧ alongside the list of names. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did; everybody there knew the work had been carried alongside the same boat.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1958 she kept the scale  alongside the long summer again when nobody else would, and  alongside the old mill, she said in 1960, that was the part nobody forgot. She kept the scale in the same counter for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the shop never forgot what had been done alongside the old mill.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. prep. 与…并排（表时间：alongside the long summer）
B. prep. 与…并排（表处所：alongside the old mill）
C. prep. 与…一起（表方式／状态：alongside the men of the village）
D. prep. 与…一起（引出施动者或相关的人：be counted alongside his father）
E. prep. 与…并排（表原因：alongside the same need）
F. prep. 与…一起（表对象／目的：alongside the women of the house）
G. prep. 与…并排（表工具／材料：alongside the same boat）
H. prep. 与…一起（表载体／处所：written alongside the list of names）

items.q: alongside the men of the village
alongside the women of the house

answers.why: alongside 意为“与…并排”，此处引出时间 the long summer（那个长夏），说明那件小小的秤是在何时留下的。
alongside 意为“与…并排”，此处引出处所 the old mill（那座老磨坊），说明东西被放在何处。
alongside 意为“与…一起”，此处引出方式或状态 the men of the village（村里的男人们），说明这件事是怎么做成的。
alongside 意为“与…一起”，此处引出施动者或相关的人 他父亲：be counted alongside his father。
alongside 意为“与…并排”，此处引出原因 the same need（同样的需要），说明整件事由何而起。
alongside 意为“与…一起”，此处引出对象或目的 the women of the house（家里的女眷）。
alongside 意为“与…并排”，此处引出工具或材料 the same boat（同一条船）。
alongside 意为“与…一起”，此处引出载体 the list of names（那份名单）：names written alongside the list of names。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1948 年那个长夏前后，掌柜把那件小小的秤留在了柜台。（alongside the long summer）
那件小小的秤被放在那座老磨坊，谁也没有过问。（alongside the old mill）
整件事是村里的男人们做成的，账本上写得明白。（alongside the men of the village）
入冬之前，那件小小的秤已经由他父亲数过两回。（be counted alongside his father）
叔叔说，整件事是由同样的需要起的。（alongside the same need）
他说，家里从来没有人为家里的女眷做过这件事。（alongside the women of the house）

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作

answers: In 1948 the shopkeeper kept the scale alongside the long summer, and nobody forgot it.
The scale had been left alongside the old mill for three months.
The work was done alongside the men of the village, as it always was in those days.
